text:
Priya: Quick kickoff for ZephyrCo onboarding — goal: production traffic by day 30. Need alignment on stakeholders, enablement cadence, and success criteria. Top risks: exec sponsor goes on leave next week, and possible data-access delays. Who can own enablement sessions, the success criteria doc, and the 30-day timeline? Link: https://drive.example/zephyrco/onboard

Marco: I can own the technical enablement (SSO, infra, runbook). Need their expected traffic patterns and model usage to size autoscaling. @Jenna can you confirm API/service-account access?

Jenna: Yes — I'll create a service account and a sample dataset. ETA EOD tomorrow. Will also prepare a short infra checklist for day 0/day 7.

Luis: From the account side: I'll handle commercial checks. Proposed success metrics: weekly API calls, active users, error rate <1%, and p95 latency target. Heads-up: Sam (exec sponsor) is taking parental leave next week — potential renewal risk if we don't lock exec alignment first.

Priya: Noted. @Katie can you take the exec touchpoint before Sam leaves? 15 min to confirm goals and KPIs.

Katie: I can do Wed 4/3 10am PT. Draft agenda: 1) 30d launch goal, 2) KPIs to track, 3) escalation path. I'll circulate calendar invite and short slides.

onboard-bot: Reminder set: "ZephyrCo Enablement — Session 1" scheduled 2026-04-10 10:00 PST (created by Priya).

Marco: Propose we define a "Day 7" health check with concrete pass/fail: zero 5xxs, p95 latency <300ms, and at least one sample successful flow through production pipeline. Who will run day 7?

Jenna: I'll run infra and SSO checks for day 7. Priya to validate adoption signals and dashboard.

Priya: Assigning owners and deadlines here, so we don't lose momentum. Action items:
```
- Jenna: create service account + sample dataset (by 2026-04-04)
- Marco: SSO, infra runbook, IAM roles (by 2026-04-06)
- Katie: exec sync & slides (2026-04-03)
- Priya: success criteria doc + dashboard prototype (2026-04-07)
- Luis: confirm billing, contract details, and DPA status (2026-04-05)
```

Luis: :thumbsup: I'll confirm billing and attach the contract (MSA) today.

Marco: Also recommend enabling read-only log access for CSMs and Product so they can triage without engineering. I'll add an IAM role and document the access.

Jenna: Quick Q — is any of ZephyrCo's sample data PII? If yes, we need to gate on legal/DPA before ingesting.

Priya: Good catch. Luis, can you confirm DPA? If not in place, escalate to Legal immediately.

Luis: They signed the standard DPA clause in the MSA. I'll attach the signed doc to the thread.

Priya: Great — I'll draft the 30-day timeline and share after this thread. Thanks all :raised_hands: Once I post the timeline, please acknowledge owners so we can lock invites and runbooks.
